blocks.zh: 第三章：品質管理系統
blocks.en: Chapter 3: Quality Management System

blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解疫情期間法規稽查模式的轉變，以及企業如何準備因應未來的稽查風險（Q3-1）
blocks.en: Understand how regulatory inspection models changed during the pandemic and how companies can prepare for future inspection risk (Q3-1)

blocks.zh: 掌握遠端稽查（Remote Inspection）的挑戰與最佳實踐，包括文件準備、連線測試及主辦能力（Q3-2）
blocks.en: Master the challenges and best practices of remote inspections, including document preparation, connection testing and hosting capability (Q3-2)

blocks.zh: 認識遠端工作環境下資訊安全（Cybersecurity）的主要威脅與防禦策略（Q3-3）
blocks.en: Recognize the main cybersecurity threats and defense strategies in a remote work environment (Q3-3)

blocks.zh: 理解遠端工作力增加所帶來的資料完整性（Data Integrity）風險，及電子簽章與 ICT 管理的重要性（Q3-4）
blocks.en: Understand the data integrity risks that come with a larger remote workforce, and the importance of electronic signatures and ICT management (Q3-4)

blocks.zh: 學習如何建立、測試並維護完善的業務持續計畫（Business Continuity Plan, BCP），確保未來突發事件時的 GMP 合規性（Q3-5）
blocks.en: Learn how to establish, test and maintain a sound Business Continuity Plan (BCP) to ensure GMP compliance during future unexpected events (Q3-5)

blocks.zh: 本節問題導覽
blocks.en: Question Guide

blocks.zh: Q3-1 稽查風險評估 Q3-2 遠端稽查典範 Q3-3 資訊安全變革 Q3-4 資料完整性風險 Q3-5 業務持續計畫
blocks.en: Q3-1 Inspection Risk Assessment Q3-2 Remote Inspection Paradigm Q3-3 Cybersecurity Changes Q3-4 Data Integrity Risks Q3-5 Business Continuity Plan

blocks.zh: Q3-1: How should companies assess their risk ahead of their next regulatory authority inspection? Q3-1：企業應如何在下次主管機關查驗前評估自身風険？
blocks.en: Q3-1: How should companies assess their risk ahead of their next regulatory authority inspection?

blocks.zh: 中文解析與CDMO應用
blocks.en: Commentary and CDMO Application

blocks.zh: 核心概念：稽查缺口的形成
blocks.en: Core Concept: How Inspection Gaps Form

blocks.zh: 疫情期間，全球法規機構（如 FDA、EMA）暫停了大部分例行現場稽查（On-site Inspection）。這造成兩大問題：
blocks.en: During the pandemic, regulators worldwide (such as FDA and EMA) suspended most routine on-site inspections. This created two main problems:

blocks.zh: 快速擴產留下的合規缺口：COVID-19 疫苗生產設施在短時間內大規模擴產，速度凌駕於品質流程的嚴謹性，導致不合規事件（Nonconformance）增加。
blocks.en: Compliance gaps left by rapid scale-up: COVID-19 vaccine production facilities scaled up massively in a short time, with speed taking precedence over rigorous quality processes, which led to more nonconformances.

blocks.zh: 遠端工作模式的衝擊：非生產線人員全面遠距，人力短缺，品質管理系統承受前所未有的壓力。
blocks.en: Impact of remote work models: non-production staff worked fully remotely, workforces were short, and quality management systems came under unprecedented pressure.

blocks.zh: 比喻：期末大考前的自我檢查
blocks.en: Analogy: A Self-Check Before the Final Exam

blocks.zh: 法規稽查就像期末考試。疫情期間老師（稽查員）沒有到校監考，許多同學（企業）趁機走捷徑。現在考試要恢復了，企業必須趕快：1）找出自己哪些地方沒做好；2）補齊文件和紀錄；3）確認有補救計畫可以向考官交代。
blocks.en: A regulatory inspection is like a final exam. During the pandemic the teacher (the inspector) did not come to school to proctor, and many students (companies) took shortcuts. Now that exams are resuming, companies must quickly: 1) find out where they have fallen short; 2) complete their documents and records; 3) make sure they have a remediation plan to present to the examiner.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：稽查前的三步驟準備
blocks.en: Key Point: Three Steps of Pre-Inspection Preparation

blocks.zh: 步驟一：盤點疫情期間所有 Nonconformance，確認文件記錄完整（事件描述、評估、決定、後續行動）
blocks.en: Step 1: Take inventory of all nonconformances during the pandemic and confirm that documentation is complete (event description, assessment, decision, follow-up actions)

blocks.zh: 步驟二：進行 Gap Assessment，對比現行流程與法規要求，找出差距並制定關閉計畫
blocks.en: Step 2: Perform a gap assessment, comparing current processes against regulatory requirements, identifying gaps and developing a closure plan

blocks.zh: 步驟三：快速擴產的設施須進行 Comparative Assessment，評估新舊設施/流程的差異及合規風險
blocks.en: Step 3: Facilities that scaled up rapidly must undergo a comparative assessment to evaluate the differences between old and new facilities/processes and the associated compliance risk

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務思考
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Considerations

blocks.zh: 身為 CDMO，你的客戶可能同時是你的稽查者。當客戶要求查核你的 Nonconformance 紀錄時，文件是否清楚標示「疫情為不合規的原因或貢獻因素」？這一句話，可以讓稽查員對異常的評估截然不同。
blocks.en: As a CDMO, your client may also be your auditor. When a client asks to review your nonconformance records, do the documents clearly state that "the pandemic was the cause of, or a contributing factor to, the nonconformance"? That one sentence can lead an inspector to a very different assessment of a deviation.

blocks.zh: Q3-2: How will the "remote inspection" and/or "remote assessment" paradigm shift impact the industry? Q3-2：「遠端查驗」及／或「遠端評估」的典範轉移將如何影響產業？
blocks.en: Q3-2: How will the "remote inspection" and/or "remote assessment" paradigm shift impact the industry?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：遠端稽查的典範轉移
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Paradigm Shift in Remote Inspection

blocks.zh: 疫情前，GMP 稽查幾乎必須現場進行（On-site）。疫情期間，FDA 與 EMA 被迫發展出遠端評估（Remote Assessment）與混合稽查（Hybrid Inspection）模式。值得注意的是：截至本文件出版時，FDA 法規仍要求稽查員必須親身到場，遠端稽查尚未正式合法化——但遠端評估已成常態。
blocks.en: Before the pandemic, GMP inspections almost always had to be conducted on site. During the pandemic, FDA and EMA were forced to develop remote assessment and hybrid inspection models. Note that at the time of publication of this document, FDA regulations still required inspectors to be physically present, so remote inspection had not been formally legalized, but remote assessment had become routine.

blocks.zh: 比喻：遠端稽查像視訊面試
blocks.en: Analogy: A Remote Inspection Is Like a Video Interview

blocks.zh: 傳統稽查像現場面試，稽查員可以親眼看到一切。遠端稽查像視訊面試——你的背景、網路品質、螢幕共享能力，都會影響對方的第一印象。能力再強，如果畫面卡頓、文件找不到，依然可能失分。
blocks.en: A traditional inspection is like an on-site interview, where the inspector can see everything first-hand. A remote inspection is like a video interview: your background, network quality and screen-sharing ability all shape the other side's first impression. However capable you are, if the picture freezes or you cannot find the documents, you can still lose points.

blocks.zh: 五大挑戰速覽
blocks.en: Five Challenges at a Glance

blocks.zh: 事前規劃：需要測試連線、預備備援方案（Redundancy Strategy）
blocks.en: Advance planning: connections must be tested and a redundancy strategy prepared

blocks.zh: 資格稽查：全新廠址沒有合規歷史紀錄，稽查員無背景可參考
blocks.en: Qualification inspections: a brand-new site has no compliance history, so the inspector has no background to refer to

blocks.zh: 溝通障礙：語言、文化差異加上連線品質，大幅提升誤解風險
blocks.en: Communication barriers: language and cultural differences combined with connection quality greatly increase the risk of misunderstanding

blocks.zh: 線上工具：需用手機拍攝危險生產區域的即時影像，需事先取得安全許可
blocks.en: Online tools: live video of hazardous production areas has to be captured with a mobile phone, and safety permission must be obtained beforehand

blocks.zh: 時區管理：跨時區稽查可能拉長會議時間，影響雙方效率
blocks.en: Time zone management: inspections across time zones may lengthen meetings and affect efficiency on both sides

blocks.zh: 遠端稽查在 CDMO 產業已是常態——客戶的虛擬稽查（Virtual Audit）隨時可能發生。建議建立「遠端稽查就緒（Remote Inspection Readiness）」SOP，包含：預定攝影機路線（Camera Tour Route）、文件電子化索引、模擬演練（Mock Run）計畫，確保不論何時啟動都能從容應對。
blocks.en: Remote inspection is already routine in the CDMO industry, and a client's virtual audit can happen at any time. It is advisable to establish a "Remote Inspection Readiness" SOP that includes a predefined camera tour route, an electronic document index and a mock run plan, so that you can respond calmly whenever one is triggered.

blocks.zh: Q3-3: What cybersecurity changes have become necessary because of COVID-19? Q3-3：COVID-19 促使哪些網路安全變革成為必要？
blocks.en: Q3-3: What cybersecurity changes have become necessary because of COVID-19?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：數位化與資安威脅並行
blocks.en: Core Concept: Digitalization and Cybersecurity Threats Rise Together

blocks.zh: 製藥業近十年大力推動數位化（Digitalization），電子批次紀錄（Electronic Batch Records）、電子品質管理系統（eQMS）逐漸普及。但數位化的另一面是資訊安全（Cybersecurity）暴露風險急速擴大。疫情期間，三個主要脆弱點同時出現：BYOD 設備、家用網路、新式視訊平台。
blocks.en: Over the past decade the pharmaceutical industry has pushed digitalization hard, and electronic batch records and electronic quality management systems (eQMS) have gradually become common. The other side of digitalization, however, is a rapid growth in cybersecurity exposure. During the pandemic, three main vulnerabilities appeared at the same time: BYOD devices, home networks and new video platforms.

blocks.zh: 比喻：家中玄關沒有鎖
blocks.en: Analogy: A Front Door at Home Without a Lock

blocks.zh: 公司的 IT 防護牆像一座堅固城堡，但遠端工作等於讓員工把機密文件帶回家——而「家」的大門安全性因人而異。有的人用公共 Wi-Fi，有的人從不更新路由器密碼。一旦其中一個「家」被攻破，城堡的防線也隨之瓦解。
blocks.en: A company's IT protection is like a solid castle, but remote work lets employees take confidential documents home, and the security of the "home" door varies from person to person. Some use public Wi-Fi, and some never update their router password. Once one of these "homes" is breached, the castle's defenses collapse with it.

blocks.zh: 疫情資安風險數據
blocks.en: Pandemic Cybersecurity Risk Data

blocks.zh: 疫情相關網路攻擊增加 63%（Help Net Security, 2020）
blocks.en: Pandemic-related cyberattacks increased by 63% (Help Net Security, 2020)

blocks.zh: 居家辦公員工中，有 47% 曾遭受網路釣魚（Phishing）攻擊（Deloitte）
blocks.en: 47% of employees working from home had been subjected to phishing attacks (Deloitte)

blocks.zh: EMA（歐洲藥品管理局）及多家 COVID-19 疫苗開發商均遭受針對性網路攻擊
blocks.en: The EMA (European Medicines Agency) and several COVID-19 vaccine developers were all subjected to targeted cyberattacks

blocks.zh: 資安風險評估五要素
blocks.en: Five Elements of a Cybersecurity Risk Assessment

blocks.zh: 針對新技術的外部攻擊複雜性增加
blocks.en: Increased sophistication of external attacks targeting new technologies

blocks.zh: 員工工作模式改變對電子系統的影響
blocks.en: The impact of changed employee working patterns on electronic systems

blocks.zh: 現有資安監控系統識別攻擊的能力
blocks.en: The ability of existing security monitoring systems to identify attacks

blocks.zh: 在遠端工作條件下應對網路攻擊的備援能力
blocks.en: The redundancy capability to respond to cyberattacks under remote working conditions

blocks.zh: BCP 與危機管理計畫中的資安應變章節
blocks.en: The cybersecurity response section of the BCP and crisis management plan

blocks.zh: CDMO 持有大量客戶的機密配方、分析方法和批次紀錄。一旦資安事件發生，後果不只是內部問題，更可能觸發客戶合約的違約條款。建議定期執行資安風險評估，並將 BYOD 政策、VPN 使用規範、遠端存取審計軌跡（Access Audit Trail）納入品質管理體系（PQS）中管理。
blocks.en: A CDMO holds large amounts of clients' confidential formulations, analytical methods and batch records. If a cybersecurity incident occurs, the consequences are not only an internal matter but could also trigger breach clauses in client contracts. It is advisable to perform cybersecurity risk assessments regularly and to manage the BYOD policy, VPN usage rules and remote access audit trail within the pharmaceutical quality system (PQS).

blocks.zh: Q3-4: What new data-integrity risks are present because of a more remote workforce? Q3-4：更多遠端工作型態帶來了哪些新的資料完整性風険？
blocks.en: Q3-4: What new data-integrity risks are present because of a more remote workforce?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：ICT 多層次的資料完整性風險
blocks.en: Core Concept: Data Integrity Risks Across Multiple ICT Layers

blocks.zh: 資料完整性（Data Integrity）要求數據必須符合 ALCOA+ 原則：可歸屬（Attributable）、清晰（Legible）、同步記錄（Contemporaneous）、原始（Original）、精確（Accurate），加上完整（Complete）、一致（Consistent）、持久（Enduring）、可取用（Available）。
blocks.en: Data integrity requires that data meet the ALCOA+ principles: Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate, plus Complete, Consistent, Enduring and Available.

blocks.zh: 遠端工作環境下，ICT 設備多元（手機、筆電、個人電腦），數據流轉層次增加，每一個環節都是潛在的資料完整性破口。
blocks.en: In a remote work environment, ICT devices are diverse (mobile phones, laptops, personal computers) and data passes through more layers, so every link is a potential data integrity breach.

blocks.zh: 比喻：多人接力傳遞的文件
blocks.en: Analogy: A Document Passed Along a Relay

blocks.zh: 想像一份批次紀錄要從生產線傳到 QA 再傳到主管簽名——現場辦公時這是一張紙，由固定人員親手傳遞。遠端工作時，這份文件可能經過電子郵件、雲端硬碟、視訊會議截圖，每次轉換都可能改變格式、喪失原始性或讓簽名出現問題。
blocks.en: Imagine a batch record that has to go from the production line to QA and then to a supervisor for signature. In the office, this is a sheet of paper handed over by the same people in person. When working remotely, the document may pass through email, a cloud drive and a screenshot from a video meeting, and each conversion may change the format, lose originality or cause problems with signatures.

blocks.zh: 三項關鍵行動
blocks.en: Three Key Actions

blocks.zh: 建立核准 ICT 清單：IT 部門審核並公告允許使用的工具，定期更新，避免員工自行使用未審核的雲端服務。
blocks.en: Establish an approved ICT list: the IT department reviews and announces the tools that may be used and updates the list regularly, to prevent employees from using unreviewed cloud services on their own.

blocks.zh: 遠端稽查前協議：與外部稽查方（客戶、法規機構）事先書面確認共同使用的 ICT 解決方案，降低數據共享的完整性風險。
blocks.en: Pre-agreement before remote inspections: confirm in writing in advance with external inspecting parties (clients, regulators) the ICT solutions to be used jointly, to reduce the data integrity risk of data sharing.

blocks.zh: 紙本系統電子化：仍使用紙本 PQS 的企業，應優先推動電子簽章（e-Signature）解決方案，確保遠端工作下的文件管控同等嚴謹。
blocks.en: Digitalize paper systems: companies that still use a paper-based PQS should give priority to an electronic signature (e-Signature) solution, to ensure document control under remote work is equally rigorous.

blocks.zh: 對於正在推動 Type 1 電子批次紀錄（eBR）或 Type 2 OCR 手寫辨識的 CDMO 而言，這一節直接支持數位化轉型的 GMP 合規理由。遠端工作常態化後，客戶稽查員（QP、RA 人員）可能在不同時區透過不同設備審查你的批次紀錄——ICT 標準化不只是 IT 問題，更是品質問題。
blocks.en: For a CDMO that is pursuing Type 1 electronic batch records (eBR) or Type 2 OCR handwriting recognition, this section directly supports the GMP compliance rationale for digital transformation. Once remote work becomes the norm, client auditors (QP, RA personnel) may review your batch records in different time zones using different devices. ICT standardization is therefore not only an IT issue but also a quality issue.

blocks.zh: Q3-5: How can companies ensure optimal performance of business continuity plans during a pandemic? Q3-5：企業如何在大流行病期間確保營運持續計畫的最佳執行效能？
blocks.en: Q3-5: How can companies ensure optimal performance of business continuity plans during a pandemic?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：BCP 的三個層次缺陷
blocks.en: Core Concept: Three Levels of BCP Deficiency

blocks.zh: 疫情暴露了業界 BCP（Business Continuity Plan，業務持續計畫）的三類問題：
blocks.en: The pandemic exposed three types of problems with the industry's BCP (Business Continuity Plan):

blocks.zh: 情境缺口：沒有預想到「全球所有廠址同時停擺」的情境
blocks.en: Scenario gap: the scenario of "all global sites shutting down at the same time" had not been anticipated

blocks.zh: 結構缺口：各部門有各自的 BCP，但彼此不整合，危機來臨時無法協同運作
blocks.en: Structural gap: each department had its own BCP, but they were not integrated and could not work together when a crisis arrived

blocks.zh: 演練缺口：未定期進行模擬演練（Mock-up），BCP 形同虛設，等到真正用時才發現漏洞
blocks.en: Exercise gap: no regular mock-ups were conducted, so the BCP existed in name only, and the gaps were found only when it was actually needed

blocks.zh: 比喻：消防演習的意義
blocks.en: Analogy: The Point of a Fire Drill

blocks.zh: BCP 就像消防計畫。真正的火災發生時，你不可能第一次打開計畫書慢慢讀。定期消防演習（Mock-up）的目的是讓每個人都知道逃生路線在哪裡、滅火器在哪裡、誰負責通報——這樣緊急時刻才能自動反應，而不是手忙腳亂。企業 BCP 也一樣：必須定期演練、定期更新，才有實用價值。
blocks.en: A BCP is like a fire plan. When a real fire breaks out, you cannot open the plan for the first time and read it slowly. The purpose of regular fire drills (mock-ups) is to let everyone know where the escape routes are, where the fire extinguishers are and who is responsible for raising the alarm, so that in an emergency people react automatically instead of scrambling. A corporate BCP is the same: it has practical value only if it is exercised and updated regularly.

blocks.zh: 優質 BCP 的八項要求（PDA 建議）
blocks.en: Eight Requirements of a Good BCP (PDA Recommendations)

blocks.zh: 已制定、可存取、隨時可啟動
blocks.en: Established, accessible and ready to activate at any time

blocks.zh: 詳細、反映現行作業、涵蓋全面
blocks.en: Detailed, reflecting current operations and comprehensive in coverage

blocks.zh: 具備彈性與適應性，設有監督治理架構
blocks.en: Flexible and adaptable, with an oversight governance structure

blocks.zh: 符合法規要求（確保執行中仍保持 GMP 合規）
blocks.en: Compliant with regulatory requirements (ensuring GMP compliance is maintained during execution)

blocks.zh: 涵蓋遠端工作情境及所需 IT 系統支援
blocks.en: Covers remote work scenarios and the required IT system support

blocks.zh: 包含員工安全保護措施（病原體爆發應對）
blocks.en: Includes employee safety protection measures (response to pathogen outbreaks)

blocks.zh: 涵蓋供應商、服務提供商及供應鏈持續性
blocks.en: Covers suppliers, service providers and supply chain continuity

blocks.zh: 定期審查並適時更新
blocks.en: Reviewed regularly and updated as appropriate

blocks.zh: 參考標準：ISO 22301:2019 — 安全與韌性：業務持續管理系統要求
blocks.en: Reference standard: ISO 22301:2019 — Security and resilience — Business continuity management systems — Requirements

blocks.zh: GMP 合規與應變措施並行的雙重要求
blocks.en: The Dual Requirement of GMP Compliance Alongside Response Measures

blocks.zh: PDA 特別強調：BCP 中所有應變措施，除了保障員工健康安全外，必須同時維持 GMP 合規水準。這是一個常被忽視的要點——危機應變不能成為豁免 GMP 的理由。每一個應急步驟都必須在 BCP 中標示其對應的合規考量。
blocks.en: PDA particularly emphasizes that all response measures in a BCP, in addition to protecting employee health and safety, must also maintain the level of GMP compliance. This is a point that is often overlooked: crisis response cannot be a reason to waive GMP. Every emergency step must be marked in the BCP with its corresponding compliance considerations.

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO，你同時服務多個客戶，任何一個廠區的 BCP 失效都可能影響多個客戶的生產計畫。建議：1）將供應商資格（Supplier Qualification）納入 BCP，確保備選供應商清單在旅行限制條件下仍可啟動；2）客戶合約審查中加入「BCP 觸發條款」，明確通知義務與應急安排；3）每年執行 BCP 模擬演練並留存紀錄，作為客戶稽查和法規稽查的備查文件。
blocks.en: As a CDMO you serve multiple clients at the same time, and a BCP failure at any one site could affect the production plans of several clients. Recommendations: 1) include supplier qualification in the BCP, so that the list of alternative suppliers can still be activated under travel restrictions; 2) add a "BCP trigger clause" to client contract reviews, specifying notification obligations and contingency arrangements; 3) run a BCP mock exercise every year and keep the records as documents available for client audits and regulatory inspections.

blocks.zh: Section III Summary — 本節重點總結
blocks.en: Section III Summary

blocks.zh: Quality System Resilience During the COVID-19 Pandemic | 疫情期間品質系統韌性
blocks.en: Quality System Resilience During the COVID-19 Pandemic

blocks.zh: 核心要點（中文）
blocks.en: Key Points (Commentary)

blocks.zh: Q3-1 稽查風險：疫情遺留的不合規紀錄是法規稽查的核心風險點。文件補強、Gap Assessment 和比較性評估是三大準備工作。「疫情為貢獻因素」的記載是關鍵防線。
blocks.en: Q3-1 Inspection risk: nonconformance records left over from the pandemic are the core risk point in a regulatory inspection. Strengthening documentation, a gap assessment and a comparative assessment are the three main preparation tasks. Recording that "the pandemic was a contributing factor" is a key line of defense.

blocks.zh: Q3-2 遠端稽查：遠端稽查/評估的準備門檻高於現場稽查。建立遠端就緒（Remote Readiness）能力已是產業標準配備，CDMO 尤其需要隨時準備客戶虛擬稽查。
blocks.en: Q3-2 Remote inspection: the preparation threshold for a remote inspection/assessment is higher than for an on-site inspection. Building remote readiness is already standard industry equipment, and CDMOs in particular need to be ready for client virtual audits at any time.

blocks.zh: Q3-3 資訊安全：數位化越深，資安暴露面越大。BYOD、家用網路、視訊平台是三大弱點。定期資安風險評估應納入品質管理體系。
blocks.en: Q3-3 Cybersecurity: the deeper the digitalization, the larger the cybersecurity exposure. BYOD, home networks and video platforms are the three main weaknesses. Regular cybersecurity risk assessments should be included in the quality management system.

blocks.zh: Q3-4 資料完整性：ICT 多元化是 Data Integrity 的新戰場。核准 ICT 清單、稽查前協議、電子簽章轉換是三項關鍵行動，與 BPR 電子化轉型直接相關。
blocks.en: Q3-4 Data integrity: the diversification of ICT is the new battleground for data integrity. An approved ICT list, pre-inspection agreements and the shift to electronic signatures are the three key actions, and they are directly tied to the digital transformation of the BPR (batch production record).

blocks.zh: Q3-5 業務持續計畫：BCP 必須整合跨部門、具彈性、定期演練，且任何應急措施都不能豁免 GMP 合規。每年模擬演練紀錄是稽查的重要備查文件。
blocks.en: Q3-5 Business continuity plan: a BCP must be integrated across departments, flexible and exercised regularly, and no emergency measure can waive GMP compliance. Annual mock exercise records are important documents available for inspections.

blocks.zh: CDMO 全節總結觀點
blocks.en: Overall CDMO Perspective on the Section

blocks.zh: 這五個問題共同描繪出一個主題：品質系統的韌性（Quality System Resilience）。在高度監管的製藥 CDMO 環境中，法規稽查、資訊安全、資料完整性和業務持續計畫不再是獨立的功能性議題，而是相互交織的系統性挑戰。疫情加速暴露了傳統品質系統在應對全球性衝擊時的脆弱性，也為業界提供了一次難得的「壓力測試」。PDA PtC-9 的這一章節，正是幫助 CDMO 將這次測試的教訓系統化、制度化的關鍵參考。
blocks.en: These five questions together paint one theme: quality system resilience. In the highly regulated pharmaceutical CDMO environment, regulatory inspections, cybersecurity, data integrity and business continuity plans are no longer standalone functional topics but interwoven systemic challenges. The pandemic accelerated the exposure of the fragility of traditional quality systems in the face of global shocks, and also gave the industry a rare "stress test". This chapter of PDA PtC-9 is a key reference for helping a CDMO systematize and institutionalize the lessons of that test.
